Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
jeff...@hotmail.com (Jeff Kuta) wrote in message news:<621dd332.02122...@posting.google.com>...


Yeah, basically nothing is scheduled yet as far as qualifiers.
Not even the North American Championship is set in stone yet.
The whole qualifier schedule is still being worked out on the
Conclave (VEKN Prince mailing list), as is the Euro Championship
timing and location.

Applications for these events are supposed to be in by mid-
January, so by the end of January everything should be figured
out and people will start announcing them. :-)

The only one I know of that'll be soon enough that you might
need to plan for it now is Ben Peal, Grant Garvin, and Todd
Richter's Northeast Qualifier, scheduled for Totalcon near
Boston in late February. www.totalcon.com for convention
information.

Josh

totally conventional

The qualifier itself will be held on Saturday, February 21.
Registration is at noon. The tournament itself will start
promptly at 1pm.

The location is the Holiday Inn at 31 Hampshire Street,
Mansfield, MA, (509) 339-2200. Mansfield is right at the
intersection of I-95 and I-495, south of Boston.

More information about event fees and hotel costs as soon as
we hear back from the TotalCon organizers, and we'll be making
a more formal announcement soon.
